 The latest edition of The Ford Trophy is commencing on the 28th of October with Auckland Aces taking on Canterbury Kings in the inaugural match at the Eden Park Outer Oval, Auckland. The Final Match of The Ford Trophy 2026-27 will be played on the 21st of February, 2027.
 14 venues have been finalized for The Ford Trophy 2026-27. They are:
 Eden Park Outer Oval, Auckland
 Colin Maiden Park, Auckland
 Saxton Oval, Nelson
 Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui
 Seddon Park, Hamilton
 Cello Basin Reserve, Wellington
 Hagley Oval, Christchurch
 University of Otago Oval, Dunedin
 McLean Park, Napier
 Pukekura Park, New Plymouth
 Fitzherbert Park, Palmerston North
 Cobham Oval, Whangarei
 Sir John Davies Oval, Queenstown
 Queen’s Park, Invercargill
 A total of 6 teams are taking part in The Ford Trophy 2026-27. They are:
 Auckland Aces
 Canterbury Kings
 Central Stags
 Northern Districts
 Otago Volts
 Wellington Firebirds
 The tournament will be held in 10 rounds. A total of 30 league matches will be played during The Ford Trophy 2026-27. The 3 teams that finish in top places will qualify for the Playoffs. The 2nd and 3rd Placed Teams will lock horns in the Eliminator Match on 19th of February. The winner of this game will face off against the top ranked side in the Finals on 21st of February, 2027.
 The last edition of The Ford Trophy was won by Central Districts. They had beaten Canterbury Kings in the Final Match of the last edition by 6 wickets.
 Last Edition's Stats:
 Winners - Central Districts
 Runners up - Canterbury Kings
 Top Run Scorer - Henry Nicholls, Canterbury Kings (588 Runs)
 Top Wicket Taker - Josh Clarkson, Central Districts (23 Wickets)
